protocol_name: MSTT_RUL HUST preregistered calibration and one-shot external confirmation
claim_limit: HUST is a public historical dataset. The confirmation may be described as prospectively specified and frozen before study-specific HUST capacity and model-output access, not as a prospectively collected cohort.

dataset.name: HUST personalized discharge protocol dataset
dataset.pickle_security_note: Python pickle can execute code. Open only the archive downloaded from the registered official source and bind its SHA-256 in the structure receipt before parsing.

split.method: Sort physical cell IDs by SHA-256 of fixed salt plus NUL plus cell ID; first 20 are parser/calibration, remaining 57 are sealed confirmation.

soh_definition.eol_event: first genuinely observed raw SOH at or below 0.80
soh_definition.model_target: seven-cycle causal trailing mean of raw SOH after causal LOCF on the physical-cycle grid

dynamic_landmark.name: preregistered causal SOH-anchored landmark
dynamic_landmark.rule: For each cell, choose the first genuinely observed physical cycle having 0.80 < raw SOH <= 0.90, no earlier observed raw SOH <= 0.80, and at least 20 observed prefix cycles.
dynamic_landmark.future_support_rule: Observed post-landmark raw SOH through the first observed EOL cycle or right-censor boundary, and no later than landmark plus 700 physical cycles.
dynamic_landmark.no_eligible_landmark_action: retain in flow diagram and exclude from estimable paired cohort; never change the landmark after capacity access

unknown_future_forbidden_inputs: statistics computed from the complete future trajectory
task.seed_aggregation: Average the three neural predicted SOH trajectories pointwise before any cell-level metric or threshold crossing is calculated.

parser.reference_implementation: Microsoft BatteryML HUST preprocessor: integrate negative current over time within each cycle
parser.nonfinite_timeseries_action: Exclude the affected physical cycle from capacity integration; do not interpolate or bridge across a non-finite current, time, or voltage sample.
parser.problem_cell_rule: For cell 7-5 only, exclude the first two raw cycles exactly as in the public BatteryML HUST preprocessor; preserve remaining physical cycle numbers.
parser.missing_input_fill: causal last observation carried forward only; no backward fill or future interpolation

calibration.purpose: interval-width calibration and parser validation only; no model, feature, hyperparameter, landmark, exclusion-rule, or comparator change is allowed
calibration.nonconformity_score: maximum absolute SOH error over each calibration cell's evaluable observed future support
calibration.quantile_rule: ceil((n+1)*coverage)-th ordered cell score, clipped to n
calibration.insufficient_calibration_action: UQ is not estimable; continue the frozen point-prediction confirmation without substituting another calibration set

statistics.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank at the physical-cell level
statistics.effect_definition: comparator RMSE minus mstt_full_K5 RMSE; positive values favor mstt_full_K5

fixed_sequence.H1: mstt_full_K5 versus local_linear_trend on cell-level future SOH RMSE
fixed_sequence.H1_success: p < 0.05, paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and mean comparator-minus-full RMSE >= 0.005 SOH
fixed_sequence.H2: mstt_full_K5 versus mstt_single_scale_K5 on cell-level future SOH RMSE
fixed_sequence.H2_gate: perform the H2 confirmatory Wilcoxon test only if H1 has two-sided p < 0.05; otherwise report H2 effect descriptively without a confirmatory p value

required_order: structure-only archive inventory and deterministic split
XJTU-only model training or validation of previously frozen v0.2.0-SOH weights
evaluator source and model freeze plus independently timestamped receipt
calibration quantile freeze plus independently timestamped receipt
write one-shot confirmation-open receipt before reading any of the 57 confirmation pickles
one deterministic confirmation evaluation with exact-code resume allowed only after an interrupted run
governance.minimum_evaluator_receipt: 40-character Git commit plus immutable public release/DOI locator bound to evaluator-freeze SHA-256
governance.minimum_calibration_receipt: 40-character Git commit plus immutable public release/DOI locator bound to calibration-freeze SHA-256
governance.post_confirmation_changes: Any changed model, parser, protocol, split, feature, landmark, exclusion rule, metric, or statistic is a new exploratory version and cannot replace v0.3.0 confirmation.
